commentary.text: 90+8' Craig Pawson is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
90+6' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Bart Verbruggen anticipates well and smothers the ball.
90+3' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored!
90+1' It looks like James Milner (Brighton) saw red with that tackle. Craig Pawson won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
90' The referee signals a substitution. Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton) is brought on as a substitute for Danny Welbeck.
89' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Yankuba Minteh is replaced by Diego Coppola (Brighton).
88' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
86' Substitution. Bruno Guimaraes will be replaced by William Osula (Newcastle Utd).

84' 2 - 1 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Danny Welbeck (Brighton) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the left side of the net.
84' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
82' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
81' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) takes the resultant free kick from distance and swings it into the box, but the goalkeeper climbs high to collect the ball.
80' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) was too forceful with his tackle and Craig Pawson interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
79' A player from Newcastle commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
79' Newcastle take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
79' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
76' 1 - 1 GOAL! Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Lewis Miley provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 1:1.
75' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Newcastle players are visibly unhappy with the call.
75' Referee Craig Pawson makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Newcastle. Let’s see what happens!
74' Surely that's handball by one of the Brighton players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
74' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) produces a promising shot towards the left side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Bart Verbruggen thwarts him and the score remains the same.
72' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Craig Pawson no option but to blow his whistle.
71' Today's match ends for Carlos Baleba who will be replaced by James Milner (Brighton).
71' Here's the change. Georginio Rutter leaves the pitch and Stefanos Tzimas (Brighton) comes on as a substitute.
70' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Sandro Tonali will be replaced by Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd).
70' It will be a substitution. Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is ready to enter the pitch as Anthony Gordon walks off.
69' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

68' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) prepares to take a corner kick.
66' The Newcastle players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
62' Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
58' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
57' The Brighton players are exchanging some short passes.
55' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.

53' CLOSE! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
52' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

50' What a miss! Yasin Ayari (Brighton) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
48' The resulting set piece from Brighton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
46' Half-time substitution. Anthony Elanga is replaced by Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Eddie Howe gives a chance to Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) and Joelinton is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' Craig Pawson has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Craig Pawson has a clear sight and sees a foul from Yasin Ayari (Brighton).
45+1' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) steps up to send the ball in.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
43' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
41' 1 - 0 Goal! Georginio Rutter gets to the ball, slips Danny Welbeck (Brighton) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 1:0.
38' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
36' Fabian Hurzeler is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Diego Gomez suffers an injury and Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) comes on.
34' The Newcastle players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

32' Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
30' Diego Gomez (Brighton) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
28' Diego Gomez (Brighton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
27' Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) is able to continue to play.
26' The game is interrupted now, Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
24' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
23' Brighton quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brighton.

20' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the bottom right corner, but is thwarted by a great save from Nick Pope. Brighton get a corner.

20' A neat pass finds Georginio Rutter (Brighton) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the bottom right corner, but Nick Pope denies him with a good save.
18' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
17' Brighton fail to score from a corner as Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) leaps to collect the ball.
14' Brighton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
14' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brighton comes to nothing.
14' Brighton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Brighton have a corner.

13' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Carlos Baleba (Brighton), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
10' Diego Gomez (Brighton) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
8' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Craig Pawson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

6' Close! Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
3' The linesman signals that Lewis Dunk (Brighton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
2' Direct free kick. Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) attempts to beat the opposition's defence with a fine lofted pass into the penalty box, but one of the defenders reacts well and averts the threat.
1' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) commits a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.

Newcastle will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Craig Pawson.
